# Control check: confirm repro.hlsl actually engages Payload Access Qualifiers
# (i.e. the PAQ-enabled vs -disable-payload-qualifiers comparison is a real
# predicate difference, not a no-op flag). Method: disassemble both builds
# and grep for the !dx.dxrPayloadAnnotations module metadata that DXC emits
# only when PAQs are parsed/applied (see disable_paq.hlsl test, which asserts
# CHECK-NOT on this same metadata for the disabled case).
$ dxc.exe -T lib_6_7 repro.hlsl -Fc - | findstr dxrPayloadAnnotations
!dx.dxrPayloadAnnotations = !{!19}

$ dxc.exe -T lib_6_7 -disable-payload-qualifiers repro.hlsl -Fc - | findstr dxrPayloadAnnotations
(no output -- metadata absent, confirming PAQs did not engage under the control flag)
